selection: First 12 uncollected standard-transformers models by downloads descending then model_id, metadata size (0,1] billion parameters; excludes adapter/quantized/MoE/multimodal metadata. Operational convenience sample, not representative.
limits: One worker; idle GPUs 0–3; 6 GiB weights, 16 GiB sampled RSS, 12 GiB sampled private cache; 900-second load/analyze stage limits; no scale-up.

results.scale_claim: Small dense-decoder convenience sample; not evidence of universal support or 50k-scale operation.
